---
title: "Unnikrishnan AI Lab"
subtitle: "AI for medical imaging and industrial systems"
---

**Atlantic Technological University, Sligo**

We develop multimodal and explainable AI for medical image analysis,
and use machine learning to model and monitor industrial processes.

## Featured research

- **OncoView** — AI-based breast tumour segmentation and measurement.
- **Brain tumour MRI** — Multimodal and explainable AI for glioma characterisation.
- **DAIRY-VISION** — AI for evaluating dairy powder solubility from microscopy images.
